verdict.rationale: Framer's AI agent docs mention generating 'visuals' and 'copy' directly in the project, which loosely touches copy suggestions and image creation, but there is no evidence of dedicated background removal, content-aware fill, or a standalone image-generation tool inside the editor. missing for 10: explicit background removal feature, content-aware fill/inpainting tool, dedicated image generation UI, independent hands-on confirmation of these asset tools.
